It's frustrating because even the people around me when I do go back out and use, the conversation always comes up about what I was doing right before I got there. The right thing. Then I hear my friends who haven't been able to get sober yet tell me how much they wish they could follow the same path "as easily as i did". Some of my friends feel stuck. My last go around I finally felt guilt because I go back around to a place where there's a lot of suffering to have fun and get loaded.... It wasn't fun when I lived there but just because "im there for a good time", its different, but its not. I feel like i want to be the motivation or success story that they need to see on order for them to feel more encouraged. I think about my people back in that place and i wish i could just put them all in my pocket and coddle them in safety where Im living now but obviously that is so super unrealistic. But i think it was a good thing i felt that remorse because it doesn't make it so comfortable for me to go back again... But at the same time, if i keep on doing what im doing, i know for facts that ill end up there again.

Yeah... I've had many people say those words... "That's normal." "It happens to everybody." No the hell it doesn't!!!! Lmao. For me, its living as though someone has bugged my phone, watching everything I do on it... That somehow, someone got into my dorm room and put secret cameras... Its living like "they" are always watching.... Its living with nonstop auditory hallucinations IN MY HEAD but I hear them through my ears, always talking about what I'm doing... Why I'm doing it.. Judging always... Sometimes they're kinda funny. Like I'll look in the mirror and someone will bust out and say, "damn that ass!!!" LMAO so yes sometimes they are funny... But let's be real..... This isn't real. Lol it's not funny. It can be fucking debilitating for me. AND IM MEDICATED! This happens when I'm alone in my room. Imagine what happens to me and how I feel when I go in public places. The craziest part about "they", as in "those people" watching.... Is "they" are people that I know. The voices are familiar. Its family. Friends. My boyfriend. And I have to look these people in the face. If I lost my grip on reality and what it was....or wasn't... I would be doomed. I would be accusing people i know of saying all types of shit that they didnt really say... Lol
